title: TravelAgent: Generative agents in the built environment
rationale: Strong built-environment L5 interface with observed spatial behavior; previously excluded mainly because current experiments are single-agent navigation rather than multi-agent social simulation.

title: Exploring Large Language Model-Driven Agents for Environment-Aware Spatial Interactions and Conversations in Virtual Reality Role-Play Scenarios
rationale: Spatially explicit social VR role-play case; old boundary rejected it because it is situated interaction rather than a full multi-agent social system.

title: When LLMs Recognize Your Space: Research on Experiences with Spatially Aware LLM Agents
rationale: Strong L2 bridge case for spatially aware interaction quality in a socially situated environment; old boundary kept it adjacent because it is not a population-level simulation.

title: A Context-Aware Onboarding Agent for Metaverse Powered by Large Language Models
rationale: Metaverse environment is explicit and socially situated; old boundary rejected it mainly because the system is single-agent onboarding rather than multi-agent simulation.

title: A Voice-Controlled Dialogue System for NPC Interaction using Large Language Models
rationale: Unity/NPC interaction case with explicit spatial scene; old boundary rejected it because it is a single user-to-NPC interface rather than a social simulator.

title: Mixed-Initiative Dialogue Management for Human-Virtual Agents Interaction in Forum Theatre Inspired Training
rationale: Socially staged VR scene with human-virtual-agent interaction; old boundary rejected it because training interaction was judged weaker than multi-agent social simulation.

title: TongSIM: A General Platform for Simulating Intelligent Machines
rationale: Rich spatial world platform with likely strong agent-facing inputs; old boundary rejected it mainly because the paper reads as a general simulator platform rather than one concrete social system.

title: S^3: Social-network Simulation System with Large Language Model-Empowered Agents
rationale: Collective behavior in a structured digital social environment; old boundary rejected it because structured social-network environments were treated as boundary cases rather than core environments.

title: Unveiling the collective behaviors of large language model-based autonomous agents in an online community: A social network analysis perspective
rationale: Collective behavior in an online community; old boundary rejected it because online communities were treated as adjacent rather than core environments.

title: An Open-Domain Avatar Chatbot by Exploiting a Large Language Model
rationale: Avatar-based immersive interaction is socially situated, but evidence is weaker than the main bridge-core candidates.

title: Cognitive Agents in Urban Mobility: Integrating LLM Reasoning into Multi-Agent Simulations
rationale: Already full-text sanity checked; old strict decision kept it reserve because it is closer to urban mobility population adaptation than direct social interaction.

title: Building Cooperative Embodied Agents Modularly with Large Language Models (CoELA)
rationale: Strong embodied multi-agent cooperation evidence with raw sensory observations; old boundary rejected it because it was treated as a benchmark rather than a core social simulation paper.
